Scilla section Chionodoxa , known as glory-of-the-snow , is a small group of bulbous perennial flowering plants in the family Asparagaceae , subfamily Scilloideae . Formerly treated as the separate genus Chionodoxa , they are now included in Scilla as a section. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] The section is endemic to the eastern Mediterranean, specifically Crete , Cyprus and Turkey . The blue, white or pink flowers appear early in the year making them valuable garden ornamentals . The common name of the group is based on the habit of flowering in high alpine zones when the snow melts in spring. [ 4 ]
